item.title: Elephant herd rescues calf after it falls into canal in Keonjhar village
item.description: In a dramatic late-night incident in Odisha’s Keonjhar district, a baby elephant was rescued by its mother and other members of the herd after it fell into a canal while retreating from a village. The incident occurred on Thursday night at Baradapal village under the Sadar Forest Range in Keonjhar district. item.description: A large-scale cricket betting racket operating during the ongoing ICC T20 season has been busted in Rourkela following a coordinated police crackdown. Six persons have been arrested, and more than Rs30 lakh in cash has been seized during raids conducted at multiple locations across the city. item.title: Puri lawyers block NH over court relocation plan, vehicular movement affected
item.description: Lawyers in Puri on Friday blocked the National Highway at Malatipatpur in protest against the proposed relocation of all courts in the town to an area near the Balukhand Wildlife Sanctuary. The road blockade, organised by the Puri Bar Association, began at 9 am and will continue till 3 pm as part of efforts to press for reconsideration of the relocation plan.
